newsitem.title: USA: DeVry reports increase in spring enrollment.
newsitem.headline: DeVry reports increase in spring enrollment.

text.p: DeVry Inc said Wednesday its total student enrollment at DeVry Institutes in the spring term is up 4.7 percent compared with year-ago levels.
A total of 29,460 students enrolled in March, up from 28,150 for the same term in 1996, DeVry said. New student enrollment reached 6,124, up from 5,841 a year ago, the company said.
DeVry officials said the results reflect an unprecedented number of people seeking higher education, especially technology-based programs.
DeVry owns and operates DeVry Institutes, Keller Graduate School of Management. Becker CPA Review and Corporate Educational Services.
Its shares were up one Wednesday at 22-7/8.
